title: Showgirls and cars arrive for the Dutch Schultz party
summary: Schultz's men hire showgirls and arrive in big cars.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and the Prohibition-era clubs

blocks.x: Then George came up to us before -- when we came in that night -- they told us the night before what was going to happen. And we came to work regularly at the same time. He comes up and says, well, fellows. just play whatever they want you to play. They'll treat you nice and all. It so happened that they went downtown, these fellows, his henchmen and all his gang or whatever Dutch Schultz had, and hired girls from -- what's that, the New Amsterdam Theatre there, 42nd Street. Had the most beautiful showgirls in the world.

Yeah. These girls -- well, it'll come to me. You know, you've heard of it. They hired these girls to be their companions. Paid them $100 a night. And here they come, and they're the most beautiful showgirls in the world. Now, what was that place (inaudible)?
They came -- anyhow, they came pouring in. They got their cars parked out there, big cars, Cadillacs and things.
